button.label: Insert Interlinear
button.supertip: Copy an interlinear selection in FLEx and click here, or paste the text into the document, select it, and click here. The example is drawn as a borderless table, one column per alignment slot, wrapped to the page.

button.label: Convert Table
button.screentip: Convert a plain table into an interlinear example
button.supertip: Turns an ordinary Word table -- typed by hand or pasted from a spreadsheet -- into an auto-wrapping interlinear example. One row per tier.

button.label: Re-wrap All
button.screentip: Re-wrap every example in the document
button.supertip: Also runs automatically when the document is saved. Turn that off with the LingTeX_RewrapOnSave document variable.

button.label: Re-wrap This
button.screentip: Re-wrap the example at the cursor
button.supertip: Recomputes the wrap from scratch, so columns move down when space runs out and back up when it is freed -- after a margin, font or orientation change, or an edit.

button.label: Indent
button.screentip: Move the example half an inch to the right
button.supertip: The number and the translation move with it, and the example is re-wrapped to the narrower line. The indent is the table's own left indent, so the ruler works too.

button.label: Outdent
button.screentip: Move the example half an inch to the left

button.label: Split Column
button.screentip: Split the column at the cursor
button.supertip: Pulls an affix, clitic or reduplicant out into an alignment column of its own, carrying the morpheme break character onto the start of the new column on every interlinear tier. Use it to morpheme-align part of an otherwise word-aligned example.

button.label: Merge Columns
button.supertip: Select across several cells to merge exactly those. With the cursor in a single cell, that column is merged with the one after it.

toggleButton.label: By Word
toggleButton.screentip: New examples: one column per word
toggleButton.supertip: Enclitics stay in their host's column. Stored in this document; examples already on the page are unchanged until inserted again.

toggleButton.label: By Morpheme
toggleButton.screentip: New examples: one column per morpheme
toggleButton.supertip: Enclitic columns never start a wrap line. Stored in this document; examples already on the page are unchanged until inserted again.

toggleButton.label: Re-wrap on Save
toggleButton.screentip: Re-wrap every example when this document is saved

toggleButton.label: Re-wrap on Leave
toggleButton.screentip: Re-wrap an example as soon as the cursor leaves it
toggleButton.supertip: On by default. It fires only when the cursor leaves an example, never while you type inside one, and the cursor stays where you clicked.

toggleButton.label: Numbers
toggleButton.screentip: Number new examples (1), (2)... with Word list numbering
toggleButton.supertip: A number line above the table, continuing through the document, so deleting or moving an example renumbers the rest. To restart per chapter, link level 1 of the LingTeX Example Number list style to Heading 1 and set NumberLevel to 2.

toggleButton.label: First Capital
toggleButton.screentip: Grammatical glosses as Erg / 3Sg; off, uniform small capitals

button.label: Settings
button.screentip: Show every setting stored in this document

button.label: Reset Styles
button.screentip: Make the LingTeX styles follow this document's Normal style again, and re-wrap
button.supertip: Replaces any size or font you set on a LingTeX style yourself. Asks first.

button.label: Spacing and Styles
button.supertip: Every spacing an example has, at every level and in every direction, and the font of every LingTeX style. Each box left empty keeps the default, or follows the Normal style.

button.label: Install Shortcuts
button.screentip: Bind every command to Ctrl+Alt (Cmd+Option on Mac) + a letter
button.supertip: Installed in the Normal template, so they work in every document. LingTeXRemoveShortcuts takes them out again.

button.label: Check Glossing
button.screentip: Check the example against the glossing conventions
button.supertip: Reports columns whose cells disagree about a morpheme break character, spaces inside interlinear cells, form and gloss showing a different number of morpheme breaks, and unmatched infix brackets. Offers to fix the ones that have a single right answer. Grammatical glosses are recognised by their shape, so your own abbreviations are never flagged as unknown.

editBox.label: Before
editBox.supertip: In points, on the first row of every example. Leave the box empty for none.

editBox.label: After
editBox.supertip: In points, after the translation, or after the last row when there is none. Leave the box empty for the translation style's own spacing (3 pt).

editBox.label: Left
editBox.screentip: Left indent of every NEW example
editBox.supertip: In points. Leave the box empty and a new example takes the indent of the paragraph it is inserted into; Indent and Outdent, and the ruler, still move an example that is already on the page.

editBox.label: Right
editBox.supertip: In points: the wrap lines and the translation stop this far short of the right margin. Leave the box empty for none.

editBox.label: Line gap
editBox.screentip: Space between the wrap lines of an example
editBox.supertip: In points, under the last tier of each wrap line but the last. Leave the box empty for 6.

editBox.label: Continuation
editBox.screentip: Extra indent of every wrap line after the first
editBox.supertip: In points. Leave the box empty for 0, a flush-left continuation that keeps the columns of long examples comparable.

editBox.label: Tier gap
editBox.screentip: Space between the tiers of one wrap line
editBox.supertip: In points, under every tier row but the last of its wrap line. Leave the box empty for 0.

editBox.label: Column gap
editBox.supertip: In points, added to the right of every column's widest cell. Leave the box empty for 6.

editBox.label: Number
editBox.supertip: In points: the cell that holds (1), (2)... at the start of every row of a numbered example. Everything after the number starts here. Leave the box empty for 36.

editBox.label: Left
editBox.supertip: In points, inside every cell; the columns are widened to keep the text at its measured width. Leave the box empty for 0.

editBox.label: Right
editBox.supertip: In points, inside every cell; the columns are widened to keep the text at its measured width. Leave the box empty for 0.

editBox.label: Top
editBox.supertip: In points, inside every cell of every row. Leave the box empty for 0.

editBox.label: Bottom
editBox.supertip: In points, inside every cell of every row. Leave the box empty for 0.

editBox.label: Above
editBox.screentip: Space between the last row and the translation
editBox.supertip: In points, before the first translation paragraph. Leave the box empty for the LingTeX Free style's own spacing (none).

editBox.label: Between
editBox.supertip: In points, after every translation paragraph but the last. Leave the box empty for the LingTeX Free style's own spacing (3 pt).

dropDown.label: Style
dropDown.screentip: Which LingTeX style the boxes beside show
dropDown.supertip: One paragraph style per tier, a character style for grammatical glosses in small capitals, and the paragraph style of the number cell. Restyle one and every example in the document follows on its next re-wrap.

editBox.label: Font
editBox.supertip: Empty: the style follows the document's Normal style, so changing the body font changes the examples too. Type a font name to pin one.

editBox.label: Size
editBox.supertip: In points. Empty: the style follows the Normal style's size, so examples grow and shrink with the body text on their next re-wrap.

toggleButton.label: Italic
toggleButton.supertip: The object language is conventionally italic; the glosses upright. Vernacular and Morphemes start italic.

toggleButton.label: Small Caps
toggleButton.screentip: Small capitals, for the selected style
toggleButton.supertip: Grammatical Gloss is small capitals by design: the renderer stores glosses in lower case and lets this style draw them as small capitals, which read-back reverses.

button.label: Modify in Word
button.screentip: Open Word's Style dialog on the selected style
button.supertip: For everything the ribbon does not show: colour, borders, language, the paragraph format. Changes made there are drawn at once.

button.label: Reset This Style
button.screentip: Put the selected style back to what a fresh document gets
button.supertip: Follows Normal again; italic for Vernacular and Morphemes, small capitals for Grammatical Gloss. Asks first.

button.label: Re-wrap All
button.screentip: Re-wrap every example in the document
button.supertip: Every change on this tab is drawn as soon as it is made; this is for a change made in Word's own Style dialog or in the Styles pane.

button.label: Settings
button.screentip: List every setting stored in this document
